description: Accept a risk (write — admin): records you as approver, now, the rationale and expiry. Renews an accepted risk. Also accepts a standards exception. A platform key without a user gets 403.

expires_on.description: Date the acceptance lapses (YYYY-MM-DD); must be after today (400 otherwise)

rationale.description: Why the risk is accepted (required, non-blank; stored trimmed). Blank is refused

risk_code.description: Risk code — catalog R-XX-N or custom R-ORG-N — obtain from scf_list_risks or scf_list_custom_risks

name: scf_accept_risk
